content: Flatpak and subprocesses: a bundled interpreter inside the sandbox runs normally with Process.start; only escaping to the host needs flatpak-spawn --host, which requires --talk-name=org.freedesktop.Flatpak (an effectively unsandboxed hole). For a Python sidecar this means the interpreter, its site-packages, and any grandchild (claude-agent-sdk spawns the Node-based claude CLI) must all be bundled in the flatpak, plus --share=network. Flatpak also blocks the Registry interface for app id, replacing it with $FLATPAK_ID, and libsecret access needs an explicit --talk-name=org.freedesktop.secrets hole rather than the sandbox-native org.freedesktop.portal.Secret.
